samples.question: On a white canvas a field of equal-sized dark dots is drawn. Look at the whole arrangement of dots together. Do the dots form one regular grid -- laid out in straight rows and straight columns with an equal, even spacing, every dot's nearest neighbours all at essentially the same distance -- or are they scattered at irregular, random positions? Choose: yes if they form a regular grid, no if they are an irregular scatter.
